name: synology-nas
description: Full control of a Synology DiskStation (DSM 7.x) from Claude Code. Bundles an MCP server that authenticates to the DSM Web API and exposes both a generic passthrough reaching every SYNO.* API (~870 on a DS1817+) and 64 curated tools for system health, logs, storage, snapshots, files, downloads, containers (Container Manager), packages, users, shares, firewall, DSM updates and backups — destructive tools confirm-gated — plus a control skill and slash-command workflows.
